verdicts.reason: Valmyndigheten's election IT support, in which the roll is produced, is operated, developed and monitored by Skatteverket (Swedish state agency), and the evidence names no outside provider.

The evidence shows IBM Svenska AB (US-controlled IBM) running the road traffic register under the 2015 outsourcing contract, but that describes the 2015-2017 arrangement. Transportstyrelsen later moved its IT operations back in-house after the 2017 scandal, and nothing in the evidence establishes who runs it today.
Valmyndigheten's election administration IT is operated by Skatteverket (Swedish state agency) on its behalf.
RIX-INST runs on the Eurosystem's TIPS platform (EU), and RIX-RTGS is still operated by Sveriges riksbank (a move to T2 is only planned), so the only outside dependency is EU and none is non-EU.
